title: Application to approve co-op rehab project at 48-50 Convent Avenue
summary: The Council approved HPD's urban development action area project to rehabilitate four buildings at 48-50 Convent Avenue, 453-455 West 125th Street and 12-14 Old Broadway in Manhattan's Manhattanville neighborhood. The project will convert the buildings into about 75 affordable cooperative units, with occupied apartments sold to existing tenants for $2,500 and vacant units priced for households earning up to 120% of area median income. Rehabilitation is expected to take about 42 months from closing to cooperative conversion.
